postalCode.label: NNNNN
postalCode.usage: Use a five-digit value only with time-bound evidence from Grupo Empresarial Correos de Cuba or an exactly licensed UPU release. The dated UPU addressing sheet establishes syntax and layout, not current nationwide assignments. A valid string, postal zone, locality, ONEI or IDERC area, GEOCUBA map, OSM object, containment, proximity or model surface is not automatically current postal assignment, official full-code polygon, exact civic address, building relation, occupant identity or delivery entitlement. Preserve s/n, between-street and P.O. Box elements. Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared address-ID-to-building-ID relation; AGID remains an independent versioned crosswalk.

postalCode.source: USPS Addresses 3.0 / ZIP Code Lookup / AIS Products / Publication 28 (October 2024) / U.S. Census ZCTA 2020 and TIGER/Line / Census Geocoder / USDOT National Address Database (NAD) / USGS National Structures Dataset / HUD USPS ZIP Crosswalk / OpenStreetMap

postalCode.label: 5 digits or ZIP+4
postalCode.usage: USPS 5-digit ZIP Codes and ZIP+4 are delivery-network, delivery-point, street, rural-route, highway-contract-route, P.O. Box, general-delivery, unique-organization, military, or inactive postal objects; area-or-non-area semantics apply and no polygon is presumed. Census ZCTA is an official-derived statistical approximation, not a USPS delivery boundary. A ZIP, ZIP+4, ZCTA, geocode, address point, parcel, building footprint, containment, or proximity never establishes an exact address-building relation. Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier linked to a reviewed building identifier. Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa, Northern Mariana Islands, U.S. Minor Outlying Islands, and APO/FPO/DPO postal routing remain jurisdiction-explicit. AGID is an independent versioned spatial crosswalk.

postalCode.source: Correo Argentino CPA; Argentina Georef (IGN/BAHRA/INDEC); IGN Capas SIG; IDERA; Ley 26.209; OpenStreetMap Argentina

postalCode.label: ANNNNAAA
postalCode.usage: Use the current eight-character Correo Argentino CPA. In urban areas a CPA can identify a block face; small settlements, rural zones, P.O. Boxes and special objects can be non-area or share one code. The legacy four-digit CP is not current. A CPA, lookup, address point, parcel, containment, proximity or derived surface is not automatically an official polygon or exact building relation. Building display requires explicit evidence, and AGID remains an independent crosswalk.
